professionalSummary.text: Three‑year motor pricing analyst with proven expertise in refreshing rating factors, preparing rate change proposals, monitoring pricing models, and delivering monthly pricing packs to the pricing committee.
professionalSummary.witness: "Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure."

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared eleven rate change proposals with impact analysis, each approved or amended by the pricing committee.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared eleven rate change proposals with their impact analysis; each was approved or amended by the pricing committee, with the committee's decision recorded on the proposal."

experienceHighlights.text: Ran monthly pricing model monitoring and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log."

experienceHighlights.text: Compiled the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, clearly delineating responsibilities of analyst and actuarial team.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, recording in the pack which analyses were mine and which came from the actuarial team."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes a rate change proposal with impact analysis and committee decision record, a monthly pricing pack, and monitoring log extracts for drift cases.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: one rate change proposal with its impact analysis and the committee decision record, one monthly pricing pack and the monitoring log extract for the three drift cases, with the pricing repository references as a verification trail."
